knowledge.text: The principle-7 rewrite produced no observed change in these current pairs where the goal object was reached without prolonged search: val:0001 (examine bowl with desklamp), val:0002 (examine pillow with desklamp), val:0003 (put some mug on sidetable), val:0004 (put a mug in sidetable), val:0006 (put a clean butterknife in drawer) and val:0009 (put a clean soapbar in toilet) had identical Parent and Candidate action sequences and equal step counts (4/4, 5/5, 4/4, 4/4, 8/8, 6/6), with both sides succeeding. val:0006 still involved a short search — both sides went countertop 1 then countertop 2, took butterknife 1, cleaned it at sinkbasin 1, opened drawer 1 and delivered (P6:1-P6:8 / Q6:1-Q6:8) — so in these pairs the rewrite added no detour, no alternative route when the first new instance already held the object, and no extra post-acquisition search. This was not true of every short-search pair, however: val:0005 was also resolved without prolonged search, yet the Candidate reached pencil 1 in drawer 1 (Q5:4) and finished in 6 steps (Q5:6), while the Parent opened cabinet 1 and took pencil 3 from shelf 1 (P5:5) and finished in 7 steps (P5:7), so here the two sides followed different routes (a one-step difference) despite the short search.

The rewritten anti-revisit requirement was not sufficient to remove returns to already-observed locations within the same run: in val:0007 the Candidate repeatedly returned to countertop 1 (Q7:7, Q7:14, Q7:20, Q7:26, Q7:33) and to countertop 2 (first reached at Q7:2, then returned to at Q7:15, Q7:21, Q7:29, Q7:34) and re-checked drawers 1-6 (Q7:27, Q7:28, Q7:31, Q7:32, Q7:35, Q7:36) before finally advancing to the new countertop 4 (Q7:38); likewise, after drawers 1 and 2 had been observed without the object (Q7:4, Q7:6), the Candidate continued to drawer 3 (Q7:8) instead of switching to the still-untried countertop instances. Because the Actor keeps no persistent notes and can see only the current observation, the admissible actions and the last two pre-action observation/action pairs, these revisits are at least partly outside its visible history, so whether the rule was disregarded or was simply untrackable with that short window cannot be separated; the evidence shows the rule alone did not prevent short cycling, not that it was ineffective, since the Candidate still reached the object-bearing new instance and succeeded.
